title: Seating Spiral

examples.explanation: Right along the top row, down the last column, left along the bottom row, up the first column, then right through what's left.

hints: Keep four boundaries: top, bottom, left and right. Walk the top row, then the right column, then the bottom row, then the left column, and move each boundary inwards after walking it.
When only one row or one column is left, make sure you don't walk it twice. Check the boundaries again before the bottom row and the left column.
